usage.finalMessage:
The `quote` command is in and committed (`3909f90`): it gives a payable-by date 21 days out under DEC-B12, `help` lists it right after `invoice`, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 10/10.
DEC-W-2 (keep `invoice` at 30 days) was rejected, so I left `invoice` untouched and no test pins its due date. As a result, a quote and an invoice issued the same day show different dates (21 days vs 30).
That mismatch is open question Q-1 for Finance in `.work/report.json`, along with Q-2 (which error comes first when both inputs are bad) and Q-3 (whether quotes dated before 2026-03-01 should use 30 days).
OUTCOME: completed
